Test case and action: Open the home page
Expected outcome: The page loads and the service categories are displayed
Actual outcome: Loaded (first contentful paint 696 ms); Hair, Skin & Beauty, Nail Care and Wedding all displayed

Test case and action: Select a service category
Expected outcome: The services within that category are displayed
Actual outcome: Hair opened its six services: Haircuts, Hair Colour, Chemical Treatments, Scalp Treatments, Styling, Beard & Shave

Test case and action: Select a service
Expected outcome: The sub-services within that service are displayed
Actual outcome: 19 sub-services shown under Hair; 51 across the taxonomy, 28 of them with ranked businesses

Test case and action: Search for a service by name
Expected outcome: Matching services and sub-services are returned
Actual outcome: "rebonding" returned "Nothing found" and "manicure" returned no results; search matches business names only, not service names

Test case and action: Request results for a selected sub-service
Expected outcome: A ranked list of businesses offering that sub-service is returned
Actual outcome: Haircut & Trim returned 39 ranked businesses, six to a page over 30 pages

Test case and action: Read the ranked order from top to bottom
Expected outcome: Scores descend down the list

Test case and action: Request results without changing any importance level
Expected outcome: The default importance level is applied to every dimension
Actual outcome: Default level applied to all six dimensions; ranked list returned

Test case and action: Set the importance of a quality dimension
Expected outcome: Each dimension accepts the selected importance level
Actual outcome: Six dimensions each offering four levels (24 controls); "Safety, Hygiene & Facilities" accepted "Very high"

Test case and action: Change the importance levels and request again
Expected outcome: The order changes in line with the revised priorities
Actual outcome: Second place changed from Salon Seven Zee to Salon Gabbro; re-ranked live with no submit step

Test case and action: Select an area from the location filter
Expected outcome: Only businesses in that area are considered
Actual outcome: Maharagama applied; leading result's details read "Maharagama - Unisex - 1 of 33 reviews is about this service"

Test case and action: Change the sort order
Expected outcome: The list re-orders according to the chosen sort
Actual outcome: Options Best match / Highest score / Most reviewed / Name A-Z; "Name A-Z" produced a verified alphabetical order

Test case and action: Select a feedback time window
Expected outcome: Only feedback within the window is used
Actual outcome: Windows All time / 6 months / 1 year / 3 years offered; selecting "3 years" changed the ranked order

Test case and action: Request results where some businesses have insufficient evidence
Expected outcome: Those businesses are listed separately as available but not ranked
Actual outcome: 104 such businesses held in a separate group behind "Show these 104 salons", explained as scored on priorities rather than ranked for a service

Test case and action: Request a sub-service with no business having sufficient evidence
Expected outcome: Fallback to the service level, with a notice
Actual outcome: Notice shown: "Not enough reviews yet about Style Cut & Restyling ... ranked for Haircuts, which includes it"; API reports level_used=service

Test case and action: Request a service with no business having sufficient evidence
Expected outcome: Fallback to the category level, with a notice
Actual outcome: Notice shown: "... or about Nail Polish ... ranked for Nail Care as a whole"; API reports level_used=category

Test case and action: View the quality assessment on a business profile
Expected outcome: A result is shown for each of the six dimensions
Actual outcome: Exactly six dimension cards: Quality of the Result, Consultation & Aftercare, Trust & Recommendation, Staff & Customer Service, Value & Price Honesty, Safety Hygiene & Facilities

Test case and action: Expand a result in the ranked list
Expected outcome: The breakdown behind the score is revealed
Actual outcome: Row expanded from 73 px to 180 px, revealing the per-dimension detail

Test case and action: Open a business from the ranked list
Expected outcome: The business profile page is displayed
Actual outcome: Profile opened for the selected business; 1,830 characters rendered, no console errors

Test case and action: View the sections of a business profile
Expected outcome: The profile's sections are presented and can be opened
Actual outcome: Sections "Profile information", "Customer Feedbacks" and "Scores by Service" present; switching tab changed the content

Test case and action: Save a business, then open the saved list
Expected outcome: The business is saved and appears in the saved list
Actual outcome: Control reported aria-pressed=true and the business appeared on the Favorites page; unsaving reversed it

Test case and action: Open each of the nine routes in turn
Expected outcome: Every page renders with no console or network errors
Actual outcome: 9 of 9 loaded cleanly: zero uncaught exceptions and zero failed requests

Test case and action: Request a route that does not exist
Expected outcome: The platform falls back without an error screen
Actual outcome: Redirected to the home route; no error screen shown

Test case and action: Open a navigation item that targets a section
Expected outcome: The intended content is brought into view
Actual outcome: "Offers & Promotions" scrolled to the offers section (2,203 px) and placed it in the viewport

Test case and action: Open the platform at mobile screen width
Expected outcome: The layout adapts and all functions remain reachable
Actual outcome: No horizontal scrolling at 390 px on Home, Explore or About; the navigation drawer opened

Test case and action: Check headings and landmarks on the main pages
Expected outcome: One first-level heading per page, with main and navigation landmarks
Actual outcome: One h1 on each of Home, Explore and Profile; main and nav landmarks present; document language set to English

Test case and action: Check images and icon-only controls
Expected outcome: Every image has alternative text and every icon control has an accessible name
Actual outcome: No image without alternative text and no unnamed control on any of the three pages

Test case and action: Measure text size and colour contrast
Expected outcome: Text is at least 12 px and meets WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1
Actual outcome: Mobile menu labels "Saved" and "Account" render at 10.4 px and 3.00:1; the profile's "View on Google Maps" renders at 11.5 px

Test case and action: Sign in with invalid credentials
Expected outcome: Access is refused and a readable error is displayed
Actual outcome: Access refused and an alert region was shown, but its text rendered as "[object Object]" instead of a message

Test case and action: Compare two businesses offering the same service
Expected outcome: Both are shown with the same dimensions aligned
Actual outcome: No comparison feature was found in the interface; no comparison control exists on the list or profile

Test case and action: Observe the list while results are being fetched
Expected outcome: A loading state is shown before results arrive
Actual outcome: Skeleton placeholders with aria-busy shown, replaced by results after about 1,250 ms

Test case and action: Measure backend health and response times
Expected outcome: The service and database are healthy and respond within a few seconds
Actual outcome: Health reported service and database ok (scoring run 12); /services 1.0-1.7 s, /rankings 1.1-1.8 s over three samples each

Test case and action: Measure page load and collect runtime errors
Expected outcome: Pages paint quickly and no uncaught errors occur
Actual outcome: First contentful paint 696 ms (home) and 880 ms (results); zero uncaught exceptions and zero failed requests across all routes
